bilingual.notes: Bilingual Education (K-12) endorsement (code 7038). Issued via SBOE-approved EPP program (e.g., BSU, NNU) per the OSBE-approved endorsement programs matrix. IDAPA 08.02.02 §021 requires credit hours + a state-board-approved content/pedagogy/performance assessment + supervised clinical experience for any standard endorsement; the Institutional Recommendation form (Jan 2025) requires a Praxis content assessment per endorsement. Idaho Standards for Bilingual Education Teachers (in the 2018 Standards for Initial Certification doc, still operative for this discipline) Standard 4(a) requires program-verified L1 and L2 academic language proficiency.

eld.notes: English as a Second Language (ESL) (K-12) endorsement (code 7126). The SDE *English Learner Program Manual* (2025) uses the term 'English as a New Language (ENL)' for the corresponding teaching assignment codes; both names refer to the same 7126 endorsement. Same IDAPA 08.02.02 §021 requirements (coursework + content assessment + supervised clinical experience) apply.

sei.notes: No Idaho statute or SBOE rule mandates that all certified teachers obtain an EL/SEI endorsement. ESL/ENL and Bilingual remain voluntary specializations. The SDE EL Program Manual (2025) recommends professional development for all language and content teachers but does not impose an SEA-level mandate.

history.title: EPAA 29(100) document analysis (Leider, Colombo & Nerlino, 2021)
history.description: Leider, Colombo & Nerlino published in Education Policy Analysis Archives 29(100) a comprehensive document analysis of every state and DC's bilingual, ELD/ESL, and SEI teacher-credentialing requirements, professional teaching standards mentions, and EL-percentage figures, based on primary SEA sources collected October–December 2019. The 2019 coding of Idaho's EL-credentialing landscape is preserved as a temporally-anchored research baseline against which the catalog's later verifications are framed.

history.title: Idaho adopts the State Seal of Biliteracy
history.description: House Bill 433 (2020) authorized the Idaho Seal of Biliteracy on the high-school diploma for graduates demonstrating proficiency in English plus one or more world languages, administered through the Idaho SDE.

history.title: Idaho updates Standards for Initial Certification (program-approval date)
history.description: The 2024 edition of the *Idaho Standards for Initial Certification of Professional School Personnel* (program-approval date July 1, 2022) updates the Idaho Core Teaching Standards and adds Comprehensive Literacy Standards. The 2018 edition's discipline standards for Bilingual Education and ESL teachers remain operative for those endorsements.

history.title: SDE issues updated English Learner Program Manual
history.description: Idaho SDE published the 08/01/2025 update of the *English Learner Program Manual*. The 'Idaho ESL and Bilingual Teacher Certification' assignment-code table (pp. 40–42) confirms Bilingual (K-12) endorsement code 7038 and ESL/ENL (K-12) code 7126, and confirms Idaho's WIDA Consortium membership (ACCESS for ELLs / WIDA Screener).
